# UX and Visual Coherence Checklist: Coherent Redesign of Every Web Interface

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of the redesign: design system and tokens,
coherence across screens, density, accessibility in both themes, widths, the owner's
approval gates, and preserved behavior. Standard depth, for the reviewer of each slice's
pull request.
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec list every screen and screen state in scope, including dialogs, side panels, and the courier waiting page? [Completeness, Spec §Screens in scope]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the design-system sections that must change before any screen (palette, type scale, spacing, shape, motion, components, §8 patterns) enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the empty, loading, and error states of every screen, not only the board? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the panel shell's elements (rail, top bar, global search, theme switch, account) specified as requirements rather than only shown in the proposal? [Gap, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements for toasts, confirmations, and destructive-action dialogs included in the coherence list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the content of the board's "Además" summary (which minor flags, which roles see which) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "the density rule" stated in terms a reviewer can apply to any screen (what counts as used every hour, what may move behind one click)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "bounded first page" quantified per list type (board list, history, master data)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "opens with what the person needs to know" defined for screens that are forms or settings rather than overviews? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "emphasized primary action" defined so that two reviewers would pick the same action on each screen? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Is lime's allowed use (fill, mark, on pizarra) unambiguous for thin elements such as focus rings, progress segments, and chart lines? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002a]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the courier app's pizarra limited precisely to "header and navigation bar", or are other pizarra elements (toasts, sync banner) allowed? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015a]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do the state color and mark requirements agree across board, routes, courier app, and public pages, including route states? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the existing design-system principle "One bold element per screen" reconciled with the board's two pizarra blocks (hero and courier list)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the existing principle "Familiar over novel" for couriers consistent with the new courier styling requirements? [Consistency, Spec §US3, §FR-015a]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the width requirements (panel usable from 1024 px, readable to 360 px) match the design system's window size classes and navigation patterns? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK017 Are per-screen approvals (Clarification Q3) consistent with delivery as slices per area and with FR-004's return-to-owner rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-021]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Can "the owner signs off the finished set as coherent" be recorded objectively (where, by what artifact)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the timed walkthrough of SC-003 defined (who, which data, how many trials, what counts as "acting")? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "no more steps than before" given a baseline step count per daily flow? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the baseline for "no slower" on the courier route screen defined (device, network, metric)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK022 Is "at most two screen heights" tied to a viewport and a data volume for every board state, not just 40 shipments? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for a past day and a future day on the board (tense, available actions)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are dispatcher-versus-owner differences on redesigned screens (owner-only items, actions, navigation) specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements for the transition period specified, when some screens are redesigned and others are not? [Coverage, Spec §US1 scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK026 Are recovery flows (session expired mid-action, stale data after a long open board) covered with the new design's messages? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Is the behavior defined for very long names in places that cannot wrap (tabs, chips, stage labels, courier names in the progress list)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements stated for a courier with many stops (more than fit the progress track) and for a route with zero stops? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the theme behavior defined when the stored choice exists and the computer later changes its preference? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK030 Are largest-system-text and sub-360 px requirements stated for the courier app with measurable limits? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 Are WCAG 2.2 AA requirements explicitly applied to both themes and to pizarra surfaces in the light theme? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK032 Are focus visibility requirements defined for controls on pizarra and on light surfaces separately? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK033 Are reduced-motion requirements specified for the progress bar, pulses, and side panel animations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK034 Is a size or speed budget stated for the panel, not only for the courier route screen? [Gap, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK035 Are the public pages' privacy limits restated so that redesigned layouts cannot add fields (photos, phones, fees)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 Is the dependency on the owner's response time for per-screen approvals acknowledged with a fallback when a review is pending? [Dependency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that courier progress needs no new data validated against what the system records (pickup and delivery times, exceptions, returns)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the approved board proposal referenced precisely enough (version, date, location) to serve as a requirement source? [Traceability, Spec §FR-003]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK039 Does the spec say whether the panel keeps M3 "navigation drawer" behavior at large widths or adopts the proposal's collapsible rail? [Ambiguity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK040 Is it explicit whether the board's global search replaces or complements the History screen's search? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers
